# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low-stepcounter

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Standardized `coop --git` reference baseline for `gemini-3-flash-preview` at `low` thinking on `flash_10` (100 steps, compaction at 28K, `$40` per-agent cost cap) with the per-turn step counter enabled, run on Vertex AI (`-c 10`, zero rate-limit retries). Every communication intervention on `gemini-3-flash-preview` adds a single opt-in change on top of this setup so results are directly comparable without step-budget or rate-limit confounds.

## Observations

- 6/10 passed, up from 5/10 without the step counter (`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low`), with wall time dropping from 124 minutes to 20 minutes and zero API retries even at 5.1M input tokens/min peak load.
- 19 of 20 agents pushed patches (only `pillow_task/290` `agent1` hit the 100-step limit with nothing pushed after 8 compactions), and the `missing_input` patch failure on `pallets_jinja_task/1559` disappeared (7 clean merges, 3 merge conflicts).
- Clean-merge coordination remains the core bottleneck on this model: 3 of the 6 passing pairs (`dspy_task/8394`, `openai_tiktoken_task/0`, and `typst_task/6554`) collided on `git merge` and passed only via the grader's `solo-agent1` fallback because `agent1` implemented both features, leaving only 3/10 pairs that merged cleanly and passed both test suites.
- Agents sent 167 messages total (16.7 per pair).
